newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open little changed.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open little changed Monday in line with LME copper which was steady to firmer despite a further rise in LME warehouse stocks.
COMEX September copper was called unchanged to up 0.20 cent from Friday's close of 107.40 cents a lb.
LME copper stocks rose 3,259 tonnes to 184,400 tonnes Monday. LME stocks have risen more than 45,000 tonnes in the past week, and since the start of the year are up by more than 50 pct.
COMEX copper stocks fell 1,081 short tonnes to 28,612 short tons Thursday.
But the downtrend of the past three weeks in copper prices still looks to be intact, traders said, with demand easing during the traditionally slow summer period, while stocks are rising.
The LME cash-to-three month spread was steady around $140 an ounce early Monday.
COMEX copper prices have tumbled from 12 month highs around 120 cents a pound to a low of 101.50 cents last week, as funds liquidated long positions build during the winter and spring.
